تستحوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحُوا (tastaḥū) /tas.ta.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
# تُسْتَحَوْا (tustaḥaw) /tus.ta.ħaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَى (istaḥā)
